23	
24	        Supports both:
25	        - Single study object: {"protocolSection": {...}}

28

31

33	            List of TrialRecords.

35	        records = []

38	
39	        try:
40	            with open(json_path) as f:
41	                data = json.load(f)
42	
43	            # Handle array

45	                for item in data:

6	class StageNormalizer:
7	    """Normalize clinical stage strings to canonical stages.
8	
9	    Stage precedence:
10	    - approved > filed > phase3 > phase2b > phase2 > phase1/2 > phase1 > preclinical > unknown
11	
12	    Rules:
13	    - FDA approved product evidence sets stage to 'approved'
14	    - Explicit company stage can set stage if sourced
15	    - CTGov phase can set stage
16	    - Multiple trials: use highest active stage
17	    - Terminated-only programs do not become active
18	    - All trials inactive → discontinued only if explicit company evidence supports it
